subject.title: Feishu: replied/quoted message mentions show as raw @_user_N placeholders

question: Should maintainers set aside the dirty fork candidate and queue a fresh Feishu-only repair, or try to narrow/adopt that candidate for this quoted-mention bug?
rationale: The source-level defect and likely fix boundary are clear, but an open conflicting fork PR already claims the issue with closing syntax and uses the same broad head as the same-repo PR that was closed unmerged.

options.title: Queue a fresh narrow repair
options.body: Close or ignore the broad fork candidate and implement only the fetched-message mention parser plus focused tests from current main.

options.title: Adopt a narrowed fork diff
options.body: Preserve contributor work only if the branch can be reduced to the Feishu parser/test changes without unrelated security, session, dependency, or changelog churn.

options.title: Leave to Feishu owner
options.body: Keep this issue open for the Feishu plugin owner to fix manually with live workspace proof when ready.

recommendation.title: Queue a fresh narrow repair
recommendation.body: Close or ignore the broad fork candidate and implement only the fetched-message mention parser plus focused tests from current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is confined to the Feishu/Lark plugin boundary, where this handle is declared as community maintainer.
